question: Which attendant beings of Hari-Hara nature are included in the enumeration?
premises: They are described as having the nature of Hari and Hara.
inference: Vetalas and Cetakas of Hari-Hara nature are included.
plain_english: The Vetalas and Cetakas, who are indeed of the nature of Hari and Hara, are included.
